        "$type": "text",
        "text": "Based on the query_records tool, it appears that there are several mechanical seal options that fit the CP-200 seal. Some of the options include:

* PN-4471-B: Mechanical seal cartridge, carbon face (superseded by PN-4471-C)
* PN-4471-C: Mechanical seal cartridge, silicon-carbide face
* PN-3310-A: Ball bearing 6309-2Z/C3, pump end
* PN-3311-A: Ball bearing 6311-2Z/C3, drive end
* PN-3420-A: Grease, lithium-complex NLGI 2, 400 g cartridge
* PN-2205-C: Casing gasket, spiral-wound
* PN-2840-A: Casing wear ring, bronze
* PN-2840-B: Casing wear ring, carbon-filled PTFE
* PN-2910-A: Impeller, 245 mm, duplex stainless steel
* PN-2911-A: Impeller, 265 mm, duplex stainless steel
* PN-2950-A: Casing, cast iron, complete with wear ring seat
* PN-8130-A: Bearing temperature sensor Pt100 (TE-21, TE-22)

It is recommended to consult with a qualified technician or engineer to determine the best mechanical seal option for the specific application and to ensure compatibility with the existing system."
